name: Falaath Village

angles.text: As a shen'dorei seeking to restore your bond with the winds, you join the faithful at Falaath Village in shared contrition. There, you hope to regain Al'Akir's favor.
As a shaman, you seek harmony with elemental spirits. The faithful approach Al'Akir through penitence and religious devotion, hoping to reclaim the winds that abandoned them.

faq.answer: Marked recruits travel from Shen'dar Village to Falaath Village and report to Missionary Jasaan. There, they seek fellowship with the faithful.
faq.q: What is the quest Falaath Village?

faq.answer: Missionary Jasaan is an acolyte near the entrance to Falaath Village. Jasaan welcomes recruits sent by Sania Silverstream to seek Al'Akir's blessings.
Sania Silverstream is one of the faithful in Shen'dar Village. She gives new recruits the Mark of Akir and directs them to Falaath Village.
The followers believe their people grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The spirits abandoned them, and through acts of contrition they seek to regain Al'Akir's favor.
faq.q: Why are the shen'dorei worshipping Al'Akir?

faq.answer: The Mark of Akir is a sign Sania Silverstream gives recruits in Shen'dar Village. It identifies them as members of the faithful before they enter Falaath Village.
faq.q: What is the Mark of Akir?

faq.answer: The shen'dorei Sania speaks of are elves facing stagnation after the wind spirits withdrew their favor. Some seek atonement through devotion to the elements.
faq.q: Who are the shen'dorei mentioned in the quest?

sections.body: In Shen'dar Village, Sania Silverstream says her people grew prideful and took the bounty of the air for granted. The wind spirits abandoned them, and stagnation followed. Now penitent recruits receive the Mark of Akir and travel to Falaath Village. There, they join others who hope their acts of contrition will restore the wind's favor.
sections.title: Contrition for the Windlord

sections.body: At Falaath Village, Missionary Jasaan welcomes initiates bearing the Mark of Akir. Jasaan sees each new acolyte as a blessing from the four winds. Those who arrive may seek the elemental grace of Al'Akir.
sections.title: The Mission at Falaath

summary: At Falaath Village, marked recruits gather to seek the Windlord's favor. They come from Shen'dar Village to report to Missionary Jasaan and join the faithful.
